abstract: We solve the ten martini problem for the positive-Lyapunov part of the spectrum of any nonconstant real analytic one-frequency Schr\"odinger operator. The proof uses the intrinsic symplectic structure of the dual center of Ge--Jitomirskaya [28] and extends the Kotani--almost-reducibility strategy of Ge--Jitomirskaya--You [30] from two-dimensional centers to arbitrary finite center dimension.
hook: The ten martini problem is solved for the positive-Lyapunov spectrum of analytic Schrodinger operators.
summary: The authors settle the ten martini problem, a question about the Cantor structure of the spectrum, for the positive-Lyapunov part of any nonconstant real analytic one-frequency Schrodinger operator. They extend an almost-reducibility strategy from two-dimensional to arbitrary finite-dimensional centers using a symplectic structure. The result covers the positive-Lyapunov part of the spectrum only.
title: The Supercritical Ten Martini Problem
